padButtons.noGearDown: Gear down has no button, so the manual gearbox can't shift. Press a layout, or set it below

fixedKeys.title: Fixed keys
fixedKeys.viewHeight: View height and field of view

dualSense.adaptiveTriggersHint: L2 firms up like a brake pedal; ABS, lock-ups and wheelspin buzz in L2 and R2
dualSense.lightbarHint: Revs: green to red, flashing blue at the shift point
dualSense.revLightsHint: The five player LEDs fill up to the shift point; the mic LED shows the overtake boost
dualSense.needsChrome: Triggers, HD haptics and lightbar require Chrome or Edge. Standard rumble stays active.
dualSense.description: Adaptive triggers, USB HD haptics, rev lights and gyro steering via WebHID.
dualSense.hdHapticsHint: USB audio haptics for kerbs, slip and engine
dualSense.testTriggersHint: L2 and R2 stiffen, then buzz
dualSense.testGripsHint: Left grip, then right, then both

gyro.title: Gyro steering
gyro.toggleHint: Turn the controller like a steering wheel. The stick still steers too
gyro.lockHint: How far to turn the controller each way for full steering
gyro.sensitivityHint: How much small turns steer. Lower is calmer around the centre; full lock still comes at the full tilt
gyro.connectFirst: Connect a DualSense or DualShock 4 first
gyro.recentreHint: Touchpad button while driving (hold to pause steering)

steer.rest: Hold the wheel straight ahead, then press Continue.
steer.act: Now turn the wheel about 90° to the left and hold it.

throttle.rest: Take your foot off the throttle, then press Continue.
throttle.act: Press the throttle all the way down, then let it go.

brake.rest: Take your foot off the brake, then press Continue.
brake.act: Press the brake all the way down, then let it go.

clutch.rest: Take your foot off the clutch, then press Continue.
clutch.act: Press the clutch all the way down, then let it go.

wheel.title: Wheel
wheel.noWheel: No wheel found. Press a button on the wheel to wake it
wheel.directDriveDetail: Raw and unfiltered, for direct drive bases
wheel.beltGearDetail: A light filter, for belt and gear driven wheels
wheel.rotationHint: Match wheel driver lock (1:1 up to car lock: {f1}° F1, {gt3}° GT3, {road}° road)
wheel.steerLockHint: How far round the rim full lock is. The real car's lock is the most realistic

wheelButtons.title: Buttons
wheelButtons.description: Gear paddles and a pause button are the essentials. Both paddles together select neutral
wheelButtons.capturing: Press a button on any device. Esc cancels; it stops after {seconds} s
